children: Wang Xiangxi, the former chief of China's emergency management ministry, has been expelled from the Communist Party and removed from public office following an investigation, the country's anti-graft watchdog said on Tuesday.

A probe, announced in January, found that Wang illegally accepted large sums of money, attended banquets paid for with public funds and used his position to secure benefits for others in project contracting and job promotion, according to the watchdog's statement.
